outcome: Maternal complications (postpartum hemorrhage, congestive cardiac failure)
Fetal complications (low birth weight, very low birth weight, intrauterine death, stillbirth)
cohort: A total of 50 pregnant women diagnosed with severe anemia attending RIMS, Ranchi.
finding: Severe anemia was significantly associated with maternal complications like postpartum hemorrhage and fetal complications including low birth weight, very low birth weight, and intrauterine death.
